integrity: Exact ratio reduction and asymptotic proof; embedded symbolic verifier supports algebra and example, not infinite-time proof. Public source date comes from arXiv v1 record.
scientific_limitations: Proved for positive solutions in a sufficiently small parameter-dependent sector of the undiffused ODE, beta*A>gamma/e. The origin is not claimed to be stable on the full quadrant. No global or stochastic conclusion; all priority claims subject to uninspected general planar-flow literature.
title: An extinction-rate trichotomy with a logarithmic critical law in a weak-Allee predator–prey system
